title: Re Dismissal Of An Employee From Messrs. Reuters Ltd

page_data.en:
Special Branch

CONFIDENTIAL

Misc. 845/39.
"A"
Central
Sept. 15th, 39.

1.

Re dismissal of an employee
from Messrs Reuters Ltd.

At 10a.m. 15-9-39, upon instruction received, D.S.I
Gazeley attended the offices of Messrs Reuters Ltd. No.
34 Avenue Edward VII (5th floor) and interviewed Mr.
K. Selby-Walker.

Mr. Selby Walker explained that his telephone
request was made in connection with the pending dismissal
of one named Long Cha Li (郎查理) who acts in the
capacity of chief of the coolie staff (numbering
approximately 100 coolies) and also as an assistant
compradore. The reason for the man's dismissal which
will take effect as from today is primarily "Squeeze"
and secondly, he is known to have some connection with
the Wang Ching Wei regime and has been responsible for
the suppression, and distortion of certain dispatches
received from Chungking for issue to local newspapers.

So far as is known to Mr. Selby Walker, Long Cha
Li (郎查理) is not aware of the true reason for his
dismissal but is being given a letter stating that his
services are being dispensed with due to the International
situation in Europe and the necessity for economising
and cutting down of staff. As a little recompense for
his services and in lieu of one months notice Long Cha
Li, who has been in Reuter's employ approximately seven
years, will be given one months salary in addition to the

1939年9月15日。

1.

关于路透社（Messrs Reuters Ltd.）一名雇员被解雇一事

1939年9月15日上午10时，奉指示，副督察盖兹利（Gazeley）前往爱德华七世大道34号（五楼）路透社办公室，会见了K·塞尔比-沃克（K. Selby-Walker）先生。

塞尔比-沃克先生解释说，他此前通过电话提出请求，涉及一名名为郎查理（Long Cha Li）的人员即将被解雇之事。此人担任苦力工头（手下约有100名苦力），并兼任助理买办。该人将于今日起被解雇，主要原因在于其“吃回扣”（Squeeze），其次，众所周知他与汪精卫政权有某种联系，并负责压制和篡改从重庆发来、拟向本地报纸发布的某些电讯稿。

据塞尔比-沃克先生所知，郎查理（Long Cha Li）并不知晓其被解雇的真实原因，公司将向他出具一封信函，称因欧洲国际局势以及节约开支和裁减人员的必要，故终止其服务。作为对其服务的一点补偿，并代替一个月的通知期，在路透社任职约七年的郎查理将获得相当于一个月薪金的额外款项，加上

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1939年9月15日 / 副总监 / 特别处）
（批：X / ... 9722-）
（批：C ... 10/6.）

page_data.en:
1/2.

salary due to him for the month of September.
It was understood from Mr. Selby-Walker that he had
no reason whatsoever to suspect that, due to the
dismissal of the man, possible revenge would be taken by
Long Cha Li, or his associates, by wrecking material or
delicate instruments in the near future and thus
disrupt communications, but he felt it necessary to ask
for protection for the ensuing six or seven weeks as the
business offices are free of access, even to
unauthorized persons, particularly between 10p.m. and
7a.m. nightly when no foreigners are on the premises.
In this connection Mr. Selby-Walker has been
advised to employ the services of an armed Police
watchman in the corridor outside the offices likely to
be the object of attack. (S.M. Police are posted day
and night outside the building premises in accordance with
previous instructions). Pending the selection and
training of a suitable man as a C.P.W. a Chinese Police
constable will be detailed for this duty between the
hours of 10p.m. and 7a.m. nightly.
Mr. Selby-Walker has expressed satisfaction with
the arrangements made. D.O. "A" Division and Chief
Inspector 1/c Central Station informed re above.

M. D. O. "A".    RLG           Hazler
                 Sen. Det. 1/c.    By S. I.
page_data.zh:
1/2.

他九月份应得的薪金。

从塞尔比-沃克先生处获悉，他没有任何理由怀疑，由于此人的解雇，郎查理或其同伙会在近期通过破坏物资或精密仪器来进行报复，从而中断通讯；但他认为有必要请求在未来六至七周内提供保护，因为即使未经授权的人员也能自由进入办公区域，特别是在每晚10时至次日早晨7时之间，此时 premises（办公场所）内没有外籍人员。就此事宜，已建议塞尔比-沃克先生在可能成为攻击目标的办公室外走廊雇佣一名武装警员看守。（根据先前指示，上海公共租界警务处人员日夜在大楼外执勤）。在选拔和培训合适的华籍巡捕（C.P.W.）之前，将指派一名华籍巡捕在每晚10时至次日早晨7时之间执行此项任务。

塞尔比-沃克先生对所作安排表示满意。已就上述情况通知“A”分区督察长及中央捕房首席督察。

“A”区代督察长。    RLG           哈兹勒（Hazler）
                 高级侦探长    由 S. I. 签署
